exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приказа́ть — to order, to command, to give orders, to direct; принима́ть — to take; присла́ть — to send (here, to this place); привести́ — to bring (someone with).
**приходит** — приходи́ть (imperfective): to come (to), to arrive (at) (place, conclusion, state of abandonment, anger, insanity). Wiktionary: при- + ходи́ть.

pairs: to add (to perform the arithmetical operation of addition)
to get used (to), to get accustomed
presence, attendance (the fact or condition of being present)
to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приба́вить — to add (to perform the arithmetical operation of addition); привы́кнуть — to get used (to), to get accustomed; прису́тствие — presence, attendance (the fact or condition of being present); призна́ть — to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something).
